description: Retells Daphne du Maurier’s Rebecca from the unnamed narrator’s courtship and marriage to her struggle to inhabit Manderley, the costume-ball humiliation, discovery of Rebecca’s boat, Maxim’s confession, the inquiry and the destruction of the estate. Preserves the uncertainty of Rebecca’s motives and the fire’s origin.
